svg.text: Dirty Prod Pi (192.168.1.10): old build from 2026-10-24: status by scenario
Long-running live demo (82% disk used, other workloads, memory cgroup off), 328 API paths. Reference only: offline since 2026-11-12;
destructive tests were not run on it.

svg.text: Individual tests / checks that ran (the full list is in the detail file)

Reference network, via the tunnel (3 runs): download 366.0 Mbit/s, upload 52.5 Mbit/s, ping 1.1.1.1 28.691 ms, ping 8.8.8.8 22.654 ms | tunnel request: median 300.93 ms, p95 1040.29 ms, p99 1240.45 ms, max 1240.45 ms
Box outline = test built: green automated, amber partial / manual / needs hardware, red not built. Grey square with outline = not run. Amber square = ran but void (invalid, see detail).
